'''Melik Galerha''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the war, Galerha attended meetings in the [[Jedi Temple communication center/Legends|briefing room]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CSWE" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the final [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the crisis,<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Galerha, alongside fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> [[Koffi Arana]], [[Olana Chion/Legends|Olana Chion]], [[Jurokk]], [[Ma'kis'shaalas/Legends|Ma'kis'shaalas]], [[J'oopi Shé/Legends|J'oopi Shé]], and [[Shadday Potkin/Legends|Shadday Potkin]],<ref name="Last Stand">{{InsiderCite|137|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Last Stand of the Jedi!}}</ref> attended a meeting in the Jedi briefing room regarding the Republic's [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|siege]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. The meeting was presented by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] shortly before [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] initiated [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which caused most [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] their [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]].<ref name="Episode III" />

The [[Color/Legends|black]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]], brown-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]], dark-skinned Melik Galerha<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Clothing/Legends|wore]] a set of brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] and owned a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Episode III" /> He also had long sideburns that connected to his mustache.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Melik Galerha was introduced in the film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], released in [[2005]].<ref name="Episode III" /> Galerha was first identified as such in his entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', released in [[2008]].<ref name="CSWE" />
